chapterName: 新鋟希夷陳先生紫微斗數全書卷之三

records.title: 截路空亡
underlyingLiteralLines: 甲巳申酉宫，乙庚午未宫，丙辛辰巳宫，戌癸子丑宫，丁壬寅卯宫。
records.disposition: Digital has 甲巳/戌癸 where canonical stem reading needs explicit validation. Do not overwrite the retained source normalization policy.

records.title: 旬中空亡
underlyingLiteralLines: 甲子旬中空戌亥，甲戍旬中空申酉，甲申旬中空午未，甲午旬中空辰巳，甲辰旬中空寅卯，甲寅旬中空子丑。
records.disposition: Digital has 甲戍; branch spelling needs explicit policy. Reuse retained60HHC/120iztro void runtime, do not rerun it.

records.title: 大限
underlyingLiteralLines: 陽男隂女從命前一宫起，是父母宫；隂男陽女從命後一宫起，是兄弟宫。
records.disposition: Text starts at 父母/兄弟, but no starting age is supplied here. Do not modify consumer major-period onset.

records.title: 小限
underlyingLiteralLines: 寅午戌人起辰宫，申子辰人起戌宫，巳酉丑人起未宫，亥卯未人起丑宫。
records.disposition: Only source start-palace list in this paragraph; directional qualification is in its adjacent paragraph. No modern age adapter established.

records.title: 童限
underlyingLiteralLines: 一命二財三疾厄，四妻五福六官禄。
餘年一泒順流行，十五命宫㸔端的。
records.disposition: First six source ordinal-palace pairs agree at selected lexical level. Digital reads 餘年一泒 and 十五命宫; retained Japanese working reading leaves □ and reads 十五大命宮. Treat as digital reading vs unresolved graphic reading, not a new independent variant or age15 proof.

records.title: 命主
underlyingLiteralLines: 貪狼子宫，巨門，亥丑二宫，禄存，寅戍宫，文曲，卯酉宫，破軍午宫，𤎉貞申辰宫，武曲未巳宫。
records.disposition: Digital underlying content contains 𤎉貞 while the visible presentation normalizes to 廉貞. Record the layer; do not silently conflate original characters, display normalization and translations.

records.title: 身主
underlyingLiteralLines: 子午人火鈴星，丑未人天相星，寅申人天梁星，辰戍人文昌星，已亥人天機主，卯酉人天同星。
records.disposition: Digital keeps 子午人火鈴星. The modern translation calls these 命主星 under the 身主 heading; translation is not evidence to change source role, select one star or resolve birthday/year anchor.
